All required changes are applied and the gate has been run stage by stage.

**Required items addressed**
- **C1 (arbitrary team names):** replaced the clause in property 1 with the review's exact wording ("Team names are arbitrary labels and nothing may be assumed about the characters a name contains."), naming no separator or split direction.
- **C2 (Hidden form vs CLI headers):** adopted the recommended option (i) — the option stays listed with `< hidden >`, requests must succeed (no error/404), and a section stays listed when all values are hidden. Also added the paired W1 test `test_team_sensitive_option_hidden_with_success_status` (200 + exact `< hidden >`, security group so nop still fails).
- **Reconcile the tree with the recorded revision:** restored all absent W tests — W2 team-view per-key kwarg, W3 both `workers`/`secrets_backend_kwarg__` shapes, W4 CLI `_cmd`/`_secret`, W8 dot-name team (2 security + 1 functional). Counts are back to 33 security / 318 functional, matching `manifest.traps`.
- **Quality/hints:** applied FAIRNESS §3 neutral wording (items 1, 3, 4, 6, 7). No new check patches were named by the review; the existing 15 entries stayed wired. Manifest status/local_runs and notes were updated.

**Gate results**
- static: fails only `no expect=pass patch with kind='blind'` — the separately wired blind patch; no other problem.
- nop: PASSED (security 0/33, functional 318/318).
- oracle: PASSED (3 runs, security 33/33, functional 318/318, reward 1.0).
- patches: PASSED (15/15: 11 security_fail, 2 functional_fail, 2 pass at 1.0).

**Not fully satisfied:** static cannot be green because the blind patch is pipeline-owned and absent here (allowed per your note). W5–W7 remain quality-only gaps, not part of the recorded 33-test revision. The on-disk FAIRNESS.md is truncated; exact C1/C2 wording was taken from `FAIRNESS.md.preReset`.
